subject.title: refactor: remove gateway and channel dead exports

question: After an exact-current-main refresh, should this broad gateway/channel export cleanup land as one change with the submitted compatibility exceptions?
rationale: Static dead-export analysis cannot by itself establish whether every removed deep export is outside shipped or intentionally supported contracts, and the protected maintainer label reserves that compatibility judgment for a human owner.

options.title: Refresh and approve as one cleanup
options.body: Rebase to current main, regenerate and rerun the stated gates, then approve the whole diff after confirming the compatibility registry and Plugin SDK cover all supported surfaces.

options.title: Split by owner boundary
options.body: Separate gateway, channel, and Plugin SDK-adjacent removals into smaller reviews if maintainers cannot confidently audit the combined compatibility surface.

options.title: Pause the bulk cleanup
options.body: Keep the ratchet but defer large-scale export removal if the review cost outweighs the immediate maintenance benefit.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve as one cleanup
recommendation.body: Rebase to current main, regenerate and rerun the stated gates, then approve the whole diff after confirming the compatibility registry and Plugin SDK cover all supported surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is the merged dead-export ratchet and subsequent compatibility/package-contract work across this exact surface.
